notes.scope: Named Blox Fruits progression, puzzle, summon, unlock, and raid-chip items. Temporary quest ingredients, generic materials, weapons, and fighting styles remain outside this collection.
notes.imagePolicy: Images are intentionally left null for the later image gate.
notes.sourceBoundary: The 19 rows are the approved scoped set, not a copy of the broad Items category. Source aliases are retained only when they help players match different guide terminology.

item.name: Torch
item.obtainment: Activate the Jungle pressure plates to reveal the Torch, then carry it to the hidden Desert room.
item.purpose: Burns the barrier that hides the Cup in the Saber puzzle.
item.consumedOrLost: Can be lost on death or leaving before use, but it can be retrieved again.
item.cardSummary: The Torch starts the Saber item chain by revealing the Cup in the Desert.

item.name: Cup
item.obtainment: Burn the curtain in the red-doored Desert house with the Torch to reach the Cup, then fill it under the dripping stalactite in Ability Teacher's cave.
item.purpose: The filled Cup advances the Sick Man and Rich Man steps of the Saber puzzle.
item.requirements: Torch; fill the Cup in Frozen Village before giving it to the Sick Man.
item.consumedOrLost: Can be lost on death or leaving before use.
item.cardSummary: The Cup is the water-carrying step between the Torch and the Saber puzzle's Relic.

item.name: Ancient Relic
item.source: Rich Man after the Mob Leader step
item.obtainment: Return to the Rich Man after defeating the Mob Leader to receive the Relic.
item.purpose: Fits the relic door near the Blox Fruit Gacha to reach Saber Expert.
item.requirements: Complete the filled-Cup route, defeat the Mob Leader, and be at least level 200 to finish the puzzle.
item.consumedOrLost: Can be lost on death or leaving before use.
item.persistence: Saber puzzle progress saves between sessions.
item.cardSummary: The Ancient Relic is the final key item for opening the Saber Expert door.

item.name: Key
item.obtainment: Receive the Key from the Military Detective on the Second Sea access route, then use it at the Ice Admiral room in Frozen Village.
item.purpose: Opens the Ice Admiral room used by the Second Sea access quest.
item.requirements: Meet the access route requirements, including the level 700 route threshold.
item.consumedOrLost: Can be lost on death or leaving before use.
item.cardSummary: The Key opens the Ice Admiral route that leads into the Second Sea.

item.name: Library Key
item.obtainment: Get the Library Key as a rare drop from Awakened Ice Admiral in Ice Castle.
item.purpose: Opens Phoeyu's room so the player can follow the Death Step route.
item.requirements: Defeat Awakened Ice Admiral and meet Death Step's other requirements.
item.consumedOrLost: Can disappear on death or leaving before use.
item.persistence: The opened door remains permanently unlocked.
item.cardSummary: The Library Key turns an Awakened Ice Admiral drop into access to the Death Step trainer.

item.name: Water Key
item.obtainment: Defeat the Tide Keeper on Forgotten Island for the Water Key.
item.purpose: Give the key to Sharkman Teacher to unlock the Sharkman Karate purchase route.
item.requirements: 400 Water Kung Fu mastery, 2,500,000 Beli, and 5,000 Fragments are also required.
item.consumedOrLost: Can be lost on death or leaving before use.
item.cardSummary: The Water Key is the Tide Keeper drop that starts the Sharkman Karate unlock route.

item.name: Hidden Key
item.obtainment: Find it as a rare Awakened Ice Admiral drop, with lower chances from Snow Lurkers and Arctic Warriors.
item.purpose: Opens the hidden chest beneath the Ice Castle stairs.
item.requirements: Reach the hidden chest in Ice Castle and use the key.
item.consumedOrLost: Can disappear on death or leaving before use.
item.cardSummary: The Hidden Key is the Ice Castle route to the chest containing Rengoku.

item.name: Holy Torch
item.obtainment: Enter the Tushita puzzle passage while rip_indra is alive; the timed puzzle places the Holy Torch in the player's backpack.
item.purpose: Lights five unlit torches across Floating Turtle in the required order.
item.requirements: Level 2000, access through the rip_indra gate, and completion of the five-torch route before the five-minute timer expires.
item.consumedOrLost: Temporary during the timed puzzle; the puzzle ends if the timer expires.
item.cardSummary: The Holy Torch is the timed-puzzle tool that opens Longma's hideout for the Tushita route.

item.name: Fist of Darkness
item.obtainment: Find it from a Sea Beast or a chest in the Second Sea.
item.purpose: Starts the Darkbeard summon route and can be inserted into the Secret Laboratory computer for the Cyborg route.
item.requirements: Use it at the Dark Arena summon point or in the Secret Laboratory as the Core Brain setup item.
item.consumedOrLost: Cannot be stored and disappears on death or leaving.
item.cardSummary: The Fist of Darkness connects a rare Sea Beast or chest find to Darkbeard and Cyborg progression.

item.name: Core Brain
item.source: Order after using Fist of Darkness
item.obtainment: Insert the Fist of Darkness into the Secret Laboratory computer, then defeat Order for a chance to obtain the Core Brain.
item.purpose: Provides the special item needed for the Cyborg race unlock.
item.requirements: Fist of Darkness and an Order fight in the Secret Laboratory.
item.consumedOrLost: Can be lost on death or leaving before use.
item.cardSummary: The Core Brain is the rare Order-linked item in the Cyborg unlock route.

item.name: Hellfire Torch
item.obtainment: Defeat the Cursed Captain for the Hellfire Torch.
item.purpose: Use it with 100 Ectoplasm to follow the Ghoul unlock route.
item.requirements: 100 Ectoplasm and the Ghoul Trainer route.
item.consumedOrLost: Cannot be stored and is lost on death or leaving.
item.persistence: Ghoul access is permanent after the unlock route is completed.
item.cardSummary: The Hellfire Torch is the Cursed Captain drop needed alongside Ectoplasm for Ghoul.

item.name: Fire Essence
item.obtainment: Spend 50 Bones on Death King's Random Surprise for a chance to receive Fire Essence.
item.purpose: Provides the named item needed to learn Dragon Talon.
item.requirements: Third Sea access; Dragon Talon's other training and currency requirements still apply.
item.consumedOrLost: Can be lost on death or leaving before use.
item.cardSummary: Fire Essence is the Death King lottery item used in the Dragon Talon route.

item.name: God's Chalice
item.obtainment: Find it from an Elite Pirate, the Haunted Castle Gravestone, or a chest.
item.purpose: Summons rip_indra or combines with 10 Conjured Cocoa to make a Sweet Chalice.
item.requirements: Use the Aura buttons to summon rip_indra, or collect 10 Conjured Cocoa for the Sweet Chalice recipe.
item.consumedOrLost: Lost on death or leaving before use.
item.cardSummary: God's Chalice is the rare starting point for both rip_indra and Dough progression.

item.name: Sweet Chalice
item.obtainment: Trade God's Chalice and 10 Conjured Cocoa to the Sweet Crafter.
item.purpose: Summons Dough King after the Cake Land enemy requirement is met.
item.requirements: God's Chalice, 10 Conjured Cocoa, and 500 Cake Land enemies before speaking to drip_mama.
item.consumedOrLost: Lost on death or leaving before the Dough King summon.
item.cardSummary: Sweet Chalice converts God's Chalice and Cocoa into the Dough King summon route.

item.name: Hallow Essence
item.source: Gravestone or Death King Random Surprise
item.obtainment: Pray at the Haunted Castle Gravestone or receive it from Death King's Random Surprise.
item.purpose: Summons the Soul Reaper at the Haunted Castle altar.
item.requirements: Carry it to the Haunted Castle altar and use it to trigger the boss.
item.consumedOrLost: Lost on death or leaving before use.
item.cardSummary: Hallow Essence is the Haunted Castle item for starting a Soul Reaper fight.

item.name: Red Key
item.obtainment: Deal at least 10% damage to Dough King to qualify for the guaranteed Red Key drop.
item.purpose: Opens the Cake Scientist's door so the player can access Dough raid chips.
item.requirements: Summon Dough King with Sweet Chalice and meet the 10% damage threshold.
item.consumedOrLost: Can be lost on death or leaving before opening the door.
item.persistence: The Cake Scientist route remains available after the door is unlocked.
item.cardSummary: The Red Key turns a qualifying Dough King defeat into access to Dough raid hosting.

item.name: Basic Raid Microchip
item.location: Hot and Cold or Castle on the Sea
item.obtainment: Buy it from the Mysterious Scientist after reaching level 1100.
item.purpose: Hosts one of the nine standard raids.
item.requirements: Level 1100 to buy; a Beli purchase has a two-hour cooldown, while a fruit exchange does not.
item.cost: 100,000 Beli or any physical Blox Fruit
item.consumedOrLost: Lost when the raid starts, on death, or on leaving.
item.cardSummary: The Basic chip is the standard raid-hosting purchase for the nine normal raid themes.

item.name: Advanced Raid Microchip
item.location: Hot and Cold or Castle on the Sea
item.source: Mysterious Scientist after Phoenix or Dough access is unlocked
item.obtainment: Buy it from the Mysterious Scientist after unlocking the Phoenix or Dough advanced raid route.
item.purpose: Hosts the Phoenix or Dough advanced raid.
item.requirements: Phoenix requires 400 Phoenix mastery and the Sick Scientist route; Dough requires Red Key access to the Cake Scientist route.
item.cost: 1,000 Fragments or a physical Blox Fruit worth more than 1,000,000
item.consumedOrLost: Lost when the raid starts, on death, or on leaving.
item.cardSummary: The Advanced chip becomes available only after the chosen Phoenix or Dough raid route is unlocked.

item.name: Order Raid Microchip
item.location: Secret Laboratory in Hot and Cold
item.obtainment: Buy it from Arlthmetic for 1,000 Fragments.
item.purpose: Starts the Order raid from the Secret Laboratory.
item.targetUnlock: Order raid and Core Brain route
item.requirements: Use the chip at the Secret Laboratory button and stand in the dark-blue tubes to join.
item.consumedOrLost: Lost when the raid starts, on death, or on leaving.
item.cardSummary: The Order chip is the Secret Laboratory purchase for the Order raid and its Cyborg-related route.
